title: Boxes
purpose: Find boxes, see where each stands and how many of its positions are free.
summary: Find boxes, see where each stands and how many of its positions are free.

tasks.title: Find a box with room
steps: Set [[Free positions]] to Has free positions, narrow by [[Storage unit]] if needed, and select [[Apply]].

tasks.title: Add a box
steps: Admin and manager: select [[New box]], or use Add box on a rack or shelf page.

good_to_know: Only active boxes are listed until you change [[Status]].
Container type is the box grid, by code and version.
Retired boxes offer no free capacity.

sections.title: Search, filters and sorting
paragraphs: Search matches part of the box code or name, ignoring capitals.
Without a status filter only active boxes are listed.
Click a sortable column heading to sort by it; click again to reverse. Ties keep a stable order. Choose 25, 50 or 100 rows per page; the default is 25.

items.label: Rack or shelf
items.description: Limit to a rack or shelf and everything inside it.

items.label: Free positions
items.description: Any, Has free positions, or No free positions.

items.label: Container type
items.description: The box grid, by code and version.

items.label: Site, Room
items.description: Limit by where the unit stands.

items.label: Status
items.description: Active (the default), Retired, or Active and retired.

items.label: Code
items.description: Immutable box code; opens the box. Always shown.

items.label: Name
items.description: Optional name; the code by default. Hidden until chosen in the column menu.

items.label: Rack or shelf
items.description: Path to the node holding it. Sortable by location.

items.label: Slot
items.description: Its box slot in that node.

items.label: Positions, Occupied, Free
items.description: Counts for this box. Position counts cover positions in active boxes that sit in active racks, shelves and storage units. Retired structure is never counted as capacity. Installed is every such position; Blocked are positions held out of use; Occupied have an item stored in them; Free is installed minus blocked minus occupied. Free positions are not reserved: a position is claimed only when an item is stored in it.

items.label: Status
items.description: Active, or Retired once the record has been retired.

items.label: Export CSV
items.description: Downloads the rows that match the current search, filters and sort as a UTF-8 CSV file. Any role that can read this list can download it. A selection of more than 10,000 rows is refused rather than cut short: narrow the filters and export again. Cells that a spreadsheet could read as a formula are prefixed with an apostrophe, and numbers are exact decimals. Each download is recorded in the audit trail with who exported which selection and how many rows, never the file itself.

items.label: New box
items.description: Opens the create form. Shown only to the admin and manager roles.

items.label: No records yet
items.description: Shown when nothing has been defined. Users who may create records see the create button in the message.

items.label: Nothing matches these filters
items.description: The search or filters exclude every row. Change or clear them.

items.label: These filters cannot be applied
items.description: A filter value was not valid. The list shows no rows rather than all rows; correct the highlighted filter.
